payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear methodology for how clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, specifically mentioning the use of GloVe vectors and the initialization method.

claims.text: Clusters were extracted using k-means clustering on word embeddings, initialized with 'k-means++' and run for 300 iterations.
The embeddings used for clustering included GloVe vectors trained on Wikipedia articles and in-domain corpus data.
The clustering process involved repeating the experiment with different seed initializations to minimize cluster inertia.
